candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory dependency, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, surfacing as 502s on gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable across multiple correlation IDs, propagating 503 from inventory and ReadTimeout on order, yielding 502 on /v1/checkout. Metrics confirm 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis path. Bounded to redis-timeout.
